name: trait-S03-markings-a
refs: Our signed young S03, Tuikis (project-owned): the creature, exactly. Its teal spots on the pale body are the 'spots' look.
prompt: Paint FOUR panels in a 2 by 2 grid, equal size, a small gap between them, on plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no borders, no text. All four show the SAME whole creature as the reference (same teal head and ears, pale mint body, big teal eyes, the thin head stalk, the lantern tail with its yellow bulb, same pose, same brush and soft painterly light from the top left), standing exactly as in the reference, the whole body large in each panel with clear magenta around it. Only the teal markings on the pale body change. TOP LEFT, 'plain': the pale body with no markings at all. TOP RIGHT, 'stripes': soft teal stripes running across the back and flanks, painted in the same brushwork. BOTTOM LEFT, 'spots': exactly the reference's teal spots. BOTTOM RIGHT, 'stripes and spots': the stripes and the spots together. Head, face, tail, pose, size and light identical in all four. No props, no ground, no shadow, no glow.
